description: It’s my birthday. I made it another year heart intact and full of purpose. I am so grateful to God for music and expression. I don’t know how I’d live this life without those two elements. I could never really tell you the story; all the tears, every test of faith, the doubt, the loneliness, the love. This song is an effort to acknowledge the journey the triumphs and the despair, and witnessing that somehow I find the joy no matter what the circumstance. Perhaps this is a superpower. Perhaps this is the how and the why of my life. Trusting in the ebb and the flow. Rejoicing in the ebb and the flow. Finding that Spirit is indeed all around and with me all the time. Hope you enjoy the tune. Shout outs and love to Quelle Chris and Chris Keys for the production and to Alberto López for engineering the mix and master.
credits:
